reviews.title: Insane cooling without spending crazy money
reviews.comment: This cooler is lowkey a beast. Like, temps stay chill even when you’re pushing your CPU hard. The dual tower + 6 heatpipes combo just does its job, no drama. The all-black look is super clean, and that little digital display? Kinda fire. Makes your build look way more premium than it actually costs.
reviews.author: Arizona buyer

reviews.title: High quality cooler, but requires you to install a program on your computer
reviews.comment: I purchased this for a fresh computer build. I think these are the gold standard of CPU cooling, high quality for sure. Two fans are included. There were no instructions on how to mount the fans to the cooler, but it is a straightforward process and video tutorials exist. The thermal paste I received with the unit was of pretty poor quality. Mounting it to the board was easy and took little time. I like the screen, it is magnetic but you can only orient it two ways. I personally don't think the screen on the cooler is that useful but it looks nice. The only problem I have with it is you need to install software on your PC in order to use it, and the GPU temperature would not update on mine. The size isn't excessive, it works with all platforms, the noise wasn't loud until it reached higher temperatures, and the cooling capability is good (did not exceed 75C under stress test). I like the cooler, but would probably get one without the screen and save a few bucks.
reviews.author: bart

reviews.title: Excellent cooler for the price
reviews.comment: For an used product it performs very well. A shame that mine got confussed with an already used one. Still, solid performance and CS returned me the money. Still money well spent. All accesories for compatibility were includes and the temperature are just great with a 5600G.
reviews.author: Oswaldo Ortega

reviews.title: It’s an ice cold beast
reviews.comment: This thing is an ice cold beast, and is such a great value. Buy it if your case can fit it, you won’t regret this purchase.
reviews.author: Cody Labor

reviews.title: Cooling fan noise.
reviews.comment: Looks and works Great.  cooling a R9 7950x. Running in Eco mode it sits around 74c gaming.  Stock fans where really loud once fans got around 70% speed.  Swapped out for Noctua fans and now runs quiet.
reviews.author: Andrew Skadsem
